episodes.title: Don't Eat the Snow in Hawaii
episodes.summary: Magnum investigates the death of his Navy friend Dan Cook, who has been accused of cocaine smuggling. With Dan's sister Alice, he discovers that Dan was framed and uncovers a connection to a secret operation.

episodes.title: Don't Eat the Snow in Hawaii: Part 2
episodes.summary: Magnum continues investigating Dan's death and becomes involved in a smuggling operation involving drugs, gold and a criminal from his Vietnam past. His investigation puts him directly in the killer's sights.

episodes.title: China Doll
episodes.summary: Magnum is hired to protect a valuable ancient Chinese vase. The apparently simple protection job becomes dangerous when a highly skilled martial-arts assassin begins pursuing him.

episodes.title: Thank Heaven for Little Girls and Big Ones Too
episodes.summary: Five schoolgirls ask Magnum to find their missing teacher. His investigation leads him into a mystery involving a valuable painting and the circumstances surrounding the teacher's disappearance.

episodes.title: No Need to Know
episodes.summary: Magnum is hired to protect a visiting British brigadier who is believed to be the target of an assassination attempt. The job becomes complicated by the brigadier's past and the involvement of the IRA.

episodes.title: Skin Deep
episodes.summary: Magnum investigates the apparent suicide of a famous actress after her former lover questions whether she really killed herself. The case reveals secrets beneath the glamorous world of Hollywood.

episodes.title: Never Again... Never Again
episodes.summary: Magnum helps two elderly Holocaust survivors who are being hunted by former Nazis. The investigation forces him to confront the survivors' painful past and the continuing threat posed by their pursuers.

episodes.title: The Ugliest Dog in Hawaii
episodes.summary: Magnum is hired to protect a wealthy socialite's supposedly valuable dog. What initially looks like an easy assignment turns into a kidnapping case.

episodes.title: Missing in Action
episodes.summary: A singer at the King Kamehameha Club hires Magnum to find her fiancé, who disappeared during the Vietnam War and was officially declared missing in action. Magnum's search raises questions about what really happened to him.

episodes.title: Lest We Forget
episodes.summary: A Supreme Court nominee hires Magnum to find a woman he last saw immediately before the attack on Pearl Harbor. Magnum traces the mystery back through decades of memories and secrets.

episodes.title: The Curse of the King Kamehameha Club
episodes.summary: Rick becomes convinced that a curse has been placed on the King Kamehameha Club by a Hawaiian kahuna. Magnum investigates while strange events threaten Rick and the club.

episodes.title: Thicker Than Blood
episodes.summary: T.C. becomes involved in helping a Marine deserter escape from a ship and return to the United States. Magnum and the others become caught up in the dangerous rescue.

episodes.title: All Roads Lead to Floyd
episodes.summary: A woman from Kansas hires Magnum to locate her father, whom she has not seen for ten years. The search takes Magnum through a complicated family mystery.

episodes.title: Adelaide
episodes.summary: Magnum is hired to protect a valuable show horse named Norman. What begins as a horse-protection job develops into a kidnapping plot.

episodes.title: Don't Say Goodbye
episodes.summary: A wealthy blind woman hires Magnum after she becomes the victim of blackmail. Magnum attempts to identify the blackmailer while protecting his vulnerable client.

episodes.title: The Black Orchid
episodes.summary: A wealthy and bored woman hires Magnum to participate in elaborate games of danger and deception. The situation becomes serious when the fictional scenario starts turning into a real crime.

episodes.title: J. "Digger" Doyle
episodes.summary: Someone attempts to steal tapes containing Robin Masters' latest book. Magnum teams up with security specialist J. Digger Doyle to protect the recordings and uncover the thieves.

episodes.title: Beauty Knows No Pain
episodes.summary: A woman from New Jersey hires Magnum to locate her missing fiancé. The investigation becomes more complicated than expected as Magnum uncovers the man's hidden life.
